response.description: Announcing the public preview of Microsoft Foundry support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The Azure PostgreSQL MCP Server is now natively integrated with Microsoft Foundry.  This integration enables you to build AI agents to securely query and analyze PostgreSQL data using natural language, with support for data retrieval, vector search, schema discovery, and more.  With enterprise-grade security via Microsoft Entra ID, plus support for row-level access controls, this release accelerates AI adoption across your organization.  You can onboard in minutes using the Microsoft Foundry SDK or the Microsoft Agent Framework to build agents that interact with the Azure Database for PostgreSQL MCP Server. For added data security, you can also self-host the MCP Server using Azure Container Apps or Azure Functions on their own Azure subscriptions and virtual networks. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Native Microsoft Foundry support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
